description:
Two defects, both only reachable under coverage, which is exactly how CI runs
the suite. Found when fz-f98.23 cleared the last matrix red and `cargo test
--tests` reached the `fz2_cli` target for the first time in this branch's
history (cargo's fail-fast had stopped before it on every prior run).

## 1. The clean-runtime rebuild trusted an inherited `$CARGO`

`aot_link::locate_runtime_staticlib` did

    let cargo = env::var_os("CARGO").unwrap_or_else(|| OsString::from("cargo"));

`fz2 build` is reached from an ARBITRARY environment, so `$CARGO` may be
inherited garbage. `build_stays_on_compiler2_telemetry_and_links_a_native_binary`
deliberately sets `CARGO=/definitely/not/cargo` to prove `fz2 build` does not
depend on it, and the whole command died:

    fz2 build: runtime archive: invoking `cargo build -p fz-runtime
    --target-dir .../target/fz-aot-clean-runtime`: No such file or directory

This is the ONLY place `fz2 build` shells out, so a bad value is fatal to the
command. The clean-runtime rebuild already refuses to trust inherited coverage
settings (`should_scrub_for_clean_runtime_build`); an inherited cargo path is
the same hazard and now gets the same treatment via `cargo_for_runtime_build`:
honor `$CARGO` only when it names a file that exists, otherwise resolve `cargo`
from `PATH`.

## 2. The test asserted the developer's environment, not the contract

With the spawn fixed, the same test then failed on

    assert!(log.contains(r#""source":"embedded""#))

Under coverage, `runtime_archive_plan` deliberately does NOT use the embedded
archive -- it is instrumented and cannot be linked -- and rebuilds a clean one,
reporting `"source":"isolated_coverage_build"`. Asserting "embedded"
unconditionally asserts that nobody is running under coverage. Now the expected
source is chosen from the environment and kept exact in BOTH directions, so a
build that silently rebuilds outside coverage is still a failure.

## Residual debt this ticket owns

`tests/fz2_cli.rs::coverage_environment` duplicates
`aot_link::coverage_env_present` because the latter is crate-private and the
former observes `fz2` as a subprocess. Two copies of one predicate WILL drift.
Options, in preference order:

1. Expose the predicate (e.g. `pub(crate)` plus a thin `#[doc(hidden)]`
   re-export, or a tiny shared test-support crate) so there is one definition.
2. Have `fz2` report the resolved plan in telemetry richly enough that the test
   asserts what fz2 DECIDED rather than re-deriving the decision -- the
   `resolve_runtime_archive` span already carries `source`, so the test could
   assert the source is *consistent with* the link succeeding and drop the
   environment check entirely.

Option 2 is the better shape: it deletes the duplicated predicate instead of
sharing it, and it follows [[feedback_tests_use_production_paths]] by observing
what production decided rather than recomputing it.

## Also: widen the local gate

`cargo test --lib` plus the matrix is NOT what CI runs. CI runs `cargo test
--tests` over every target, and `fz2_cli` and `aot_variadic_open` were outside
the local gate entirely. That is how a pre-existing failure survived unnoticed.
Document the real gate (all targets, plus a coverage-env pass for the
coverage-sensitive ones) wherever the contributor-facing gate is written down.

## Checks

- `cargo test --test fz2_cli` passes with AND without `CARGO_LLVM_COV=1`.
- The duplicated coverage predicate is gone, by whichever option is chosen.
- The gate documentation names every test target, not just lib + matrix.

comments.text:
SCOPE NOTE, because a commit already carries this ticket's name.

`fz-f98.24: don't trust an inherited $CARGO...` (main 417c5b0b5, PR #103) landed
both DEFECTS -- `cargo_for_runtime_build` no longer trusts an inherited `$CARGO`,
and the CLI test asserts the archive source the environment mandates rather than
the developer's. `cargo test --test fz2_cli` is 20/0 with and without
`CARGO_LLVM_COV=1`.

What is NOT done is this ticket's residual, which the commit CREATED:
`tests/fz2_cli.rs::coverage_environment` duplicates
`aot_link::coverage_env_present`. Two copies of one predicate will drift.
Preferred fix remains option 2 in the description -- have the test assert what
fz2 DECIDED from its `resolve_runtime_archive` telemetry rather than re-deriving
the decision, which deletes the duplicate instead of sharing it.

Also outstanding: documenting the real local gate. `cargo test --lib` plus the
matrix is not what CI runs; CI runs `cargo test --tests` over every target, and
`fz2_cli` / `aot_variadic_open` were outside the local gate entirely, which is
how a pre-existing failure survived an entire 14-PR stack unnoticed.

title: fz2 build trusted an inherited $CARGO, and its CLI test asserted the developer's environment
